messages:
sre-lead: Heads up: planned primary DB failover + regional concurrency ramp in us-west TOMORROW 2026-04-15 14:00 UTC. Purpose: validate failover SLOs and autoscaler response. Expected impact: brief 5xx spikes and connection resets for some in-flight requests (worst-case ~45s). Duration ~60m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-failover. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~25m. Rollback: manual promote old-primary or shift traffic back to us-east. Please ack and flag any traffic-sensitive jobs.
maya: ack — I'll quiesce nightly batch at 13:45 UTC and hold any manual exports.
alex: I'll own canary traffic and dashboards. Healthcheck quick commands:
```
kubectl get pods -l app=kvstore -o wide
curl -sS http://internal-health/kvstore/health
```
I'll watch per-route 99/95/50 and token-level error rates in Console.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: @oncall scheduled for this window (esc policy: db-failover). Reminder will fire 10m before start. Incident playbook assigned: db-failover-playbook-v3.
sam: quick Q — warm pool for dedicated hosts is 4 right now. Can we bump to 6 for the window to reduce cold starts? If yes I'll push the change.
ira: noted about analytics — we might see a flood of client retries. I'll add a short filter to drop non-critical events during the window and raise retention for detailed traces for +24h.
infra-bot: FYI: there's a dependent maintenance: BGP route refresh scheduled 14:10 UTC in us-west. If this conflicts with the failover please respond with `hold` within 20m.
sre-lead: Good catch infra-bot — prefer shifting BGP refresh +30m. @infra-bot please hold unless we need it.
alex: :thumbsup: Canary timeline I'll execute: start 14:00 UTC 5% traffic -> monitor 10m -> step to 25% at +10m -> 100% at +25m. Abort/rollback if error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m or if 99th latency spikes > 2x baseline.
maya: adding note: Dedicated customers may see session resets; CS and support notified to expect a few tickets. I'll post a templated message.
sam: warm pool increased to 6 for the maintenance window. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/234 — rolled out 13:30 UTC.
ira: filters in place. Key metrics to watch: Redis replication lag, per-route error-rate, 99th latency, and deployment failures.
oncall-bot: Channel created: #incidents/db-failover-1776504821. Alerts will fan-out there.
sre-lead: Thanks everyone. Will post a brief checklist 45m before start and the postmortem template in this thread after completion. If anyone sees schedule conflicts, speak now. /end
